questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 9 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 12 × 9 = 54 cm² — always halve after multiplying.
